{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
deduped_df = filtered_df.loc[filtered_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm the number of unique patients
n_unique_patients = len(deduped_df)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_unique_patients}')

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = deduped_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}')"}
